author: tempRes
quote: Despite the fact that Ocarina of Time is objectively the greatest game ever made, this game is so very special to me. Definitely my favorite 2D Zelda, and honestly, before the OoT remake, my favorite Zelda game period.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening

author: tempRes
quote: This game gets a lot of hate, but I truthfully adore it for what it is. The style, music, and the dungeons are beautiful to me. Traversal is fun and I love riding around in the sky. I don't like all the hurdles you have to jump though to get the Hylian Shield though.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword

author: tempRes
quote: A gorgeous game that, as many Zelda games tend to be, was far ahead of its time. I love the story and the art design most of all.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess

author: tempRes
quote: First way I got introduced to the greatest game of all time, holds a special place in my heart.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 3D

author: tempRes
quote: A beautiful game far far ahead of its time ironically enough. The best of the best at everything it started. Innovation in the gaming space at its finest
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: tempRes
quote: Loved revisiting this gem with the added content. This game changed the industry and Nintendo for the better. Love it.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

author: tempRes
quote: Incredible game that improves on nearly every facet of Breath of the Wild. This is the Zelda experience fully fleshed out in a completely open world. My biggest issue with BotW was the final boss, and that ended up being my favorite part of this game! Anyone saying this could've been DLC simply haven't payed attention nor have they explored enough.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

author: tempRes
quote: The undisputed greatest way to play the greatest game ever made. I cannot think of a single flaw with this experience. Everything about the original was improved and the new content adds so much. This game has passion and care put into every single detail and it feels like this was the game that Nintendo envisioned when they set out to create it all the way back in '98.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: tempRes
quote: One of the best soundtracks in gaming history. Unfortunately, I am garbage at this game. The biggest struggles I have with this game is that it isn't as accessible as previous installments, The vehicle selection should be updated, and I would love to see more characters/stages

author: tempRes
quote: What if Salvador Dali and Miazaki made a timeless game and then moved it off a portable that limited the beauty?

author: tempRes
quote: Cyberpunk, Breath of the Wild, Bloodborne, Batman: Arkham Knight, and so many more got genuinely BASHED for less than what this game gave us. The reviews from the critics make 0 sense, the physics engine is sloppy at best, and the main character has 0 personality. This game survives off of hype and sunk-cost fallacy. Not worth 0 physical copy, stolen codes because of lazy protection, constant delays, $2 billion and 13 years of development, and the massive middle finger that Sony and Rockstar gave everyone while giving them this game to hopefully allow them to turn a blind eye. For those who did not bother reading the terms of service, This game collects so much information on you, the FBI might start getting jealous.
